description: This file defines an internal interface ICatalog within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a remote interface for managing grain and activation state, including a method to delete activations from a silo.

classes.name: ICatalog
classes.description: An internal interface for managing grain and activation state, including deletion of activations.

methods.name: DeleteActivations
methods.description: Deletes activations from the silo given a list of activation addresses, a reason code, and a reason text.
